answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small refundable stake that thaws on a glacier-slow schedule, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes capital-expensive instead of free. Reputation then accrues only through completed work attested by independent peers, forming an upward spiral: honest agents climb toward the zenith of trust and cheaper fees, while sybils stuck at the bottom keep paying fresh stakes for zero return.
